changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT h.client_token AS client, (substr(h.business_date,1,4)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,5,2)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,7,2))::DATE AS process_date, t.arrival_id, t.sequence, t.e2e, t.debtor_account, t.debtor_name, t.creditor_account, t.currency, t.amount, COALESCE(p.status, s.status, i.status, CASE WHEN v.outcome = 'PASS' THEN 'CTV_PASS' ELSE v.outcome END) AS status, v.outcome AS ctv_outcome, v.detail AS ctv_detail, v.created_at AS validated_at, p.status AS pbsr_status, p.reason AS pbsr_reason, h.created_at AS ingested_at, p.created_at AS settled_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.crw_emission_member m WHERE m.e2e = t.e2e) AS emitted, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h.client_token, t.e2e ORDER BY h.created_at, t.arrival_id) > 1 AS is_resubmission FROM public.tx_entry t JOIN public.tx_header h ON h.arrival_id = t.arrival_id LEFT JOIN public.validation_log v ON v.arrival_id = t.arrival_id AND v.sequence = t.sequence LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e2e) e2e, status, reason, created_at FROM public.pbsr_resp ORDER BY e2e, created_at DESC) p ON p.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e2e) e2e, status FROM public.sbsr_resp ORDER BY e2e, created_at DESC) s ON s.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e2e) e2e, status FROM public.isr_resp ORDER BY e2e, created_at DESC) i ON i.e2e = t.e2e WHERE h.client_token = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal'

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, count(*) AS tx_count, sum(amount) AS total_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACSC') AS settled_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACSC'), 0) AS settled_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RJCT') AS rejected_late_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RJCT'), 0) AS rejected_late_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status LIKE 'FAIL%') AS rejected_early_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status LIKE 'FAIL%'), 0) AS rejected_early_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_resubmission) AS resubmission_count, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount::FLOAT8)::DECIMAL(18,2) AS p50_amount, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount::FLOAT8)::DECIMAL(18,2) AS p95_amount, stddev(amount) AS stddev_amount FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, process_date

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, 'CTV' AS stage, ctv_outcome AS reason, e2e, debtor_account, amount, ingested_at AS submitted_at, validated_at AS detected_at FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE ctv_outcome LIKE 'FAIL%' AND (client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal') UNION ALL SELECT client, process_date, 'PBSR' AS stage, pbsr_reason AS reason, e2e, debtor_account, amount, ingested_at AS submitted_at, settled_at AS detected_at FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE pbsr_status = 'RJCT' AND (client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, stage, reason, count(*) AS fail_count, sum(amount) AS fail_amount FROM rpt.v_fails WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, process_date, stage, reason

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, debtor_account, process_date, count(*) AS tx_count, sum(amount) AS total_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACSC') AS settled_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RJCT' OR status LIKE 'FAIL%') AS failed_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RJCT' OR status LIKE 'FAIL%'), 0) AS failed_amount FROM rpt.v_tx WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, debtor_account, process_date
